comment: Import does not authorise ICD modification — Unqualified “local modifications of ICD” can imply permissions the architecture cannot confer. Technical import capability is not itself a licence breach: distinguish unchanged international content, authorised extensions and separately identified additions. Apply the published WHO terms of use for ICD-11 content and software (https://icd.who.int/en/docs/ICD11-license.pdf), as revised from time to time; verify the terms in force at publication. ICD-11 Reference Guide (https://icdcdn.who.int/icd11referenceguide/en/refguide.pdf), §1.6.4, supports international comparability and governed maintenance.
